findings.title: DP-001: Sign-in disables the focused fields and button while busy; focus drops to body, and stays there on 429 and mfa_required
findings.remedy: Focus stays on (or returns to) a meaningful element: keep the submit control focusable (aria-disabled instead of disabled, with the submit handler ignoring activation while a request is pending or the 429 lockout is active, so no duplicate POSTs) or move focus to the status/summary on every outcome.

findings.title: DP-002: Lockout countdown rewrites a polite status every second (up to 900 announcements) and never says sign-in is back
findings.remedy: 05 §6.2: throttled, latest-value announcements; region pre-rendered empty. Announce the lockout once (and once when it ends); keep the ticking countdown aria-live=off, as SCR-152 already does. Note: Against 05 §6.2 (project standard). Not a strict WCAG 4.1.3 failure: the status is programmatically exposed; the defect is flooding.
findings.ownerReason: status messages are the live-region design

findings.title: DP-003 (advisory, D-10: not a 4.1.2 failure): Show-password toggle flips its name and aria-pressed together ('Hide password, pressed')
findings.remedy: A toggle keeps one name and flips aria-pressed (CMP-201 states: reveal 'aria-pressed="true", the name unchanged'), e.g. 'Show password' pressed/not pressed. Adjudication: D-10: name, role and value are programmatically determinable, so 4.1.2 holds; kept as a Minor (advisory) finding against 4.1.2 (the double announcement contradicts itself), routed to the component's owner as a row in #5196 (filing go, decision 2a). ADJUDICATED (orchestrator, 2026-10-31, #1323 adjudication of record — 6543611748).
findings.ownerReason: name/role/value and error identification are a primitive and pattern contract

findings.title: DP-004: The two-factor step replaces the form with focus on body and nothing announced
findings.remedy: On the step change focus moves to the new step's heading (tabindex=-1) or its first field, so the change is announced.

findings.title: DP-005: Each invite-wizard step change leaves focus on body; step 4 (codes shown once) is entered silently
findings.remedy: Focus moves to the new step's h1 (tabindex=-1) on each step change, so 'Step 3 of 4' and the one-time recovery-codes warning are read.

findings.title: DP-006 (4.1.2, with 1.3.1; re-classed from 3.3.1 by D-09): Password-change error messages are not programmatically tied to their field (no aria-invalid / aria-describedby)
findings.remedy: 4.1.2 / 1.3.1: the field in error carries aria-invalid=true and an aria-describedby to its message, so the association the visual layout implies is programmatic; focus moves to the first invalid field. Advisory: the server refusal names the current password ('Current password is incorrect'). Adjudication: D-09: 3.3.1 passes (the error is identified and described in text in an alert region); the finding is re-classed under 4.1.2 / 1.3.1 (no programmatic association), still Level A, kept; a row in #5196 (filing go, decision 2a). ADJUDICATED (orchestrator, 2026-10-31, #1323 adjudication of record — 6543611748).
findings.ownerReason: name/role/value and error identification are a primitive and pattern contract

findings.title: DP-007 (2.4.3, with 4.1.3 secondary; D-08): 'Password changed' replaces the form with focus on body and nothing announced

findings.title: DP-010: Step-up dialog closes at the challenge expiry with no warning and no way to continue
findings.remedy: 2.2.1: warn at least 20 s before the time limit and offer a simple way to continue. A remedy may only re-issue a fresh challenge on request; it never extends the old one or softens the factor (BQ-10): (a) a re-issue is a new server-issued challenge_id with the same factors; the step-up failure count (the session's failures_remaining), the read-only downgrade after the third failure and the auth.step_up_required audit continue across a re-issue, which never resets the count; (b) at expiry the typed password and code are discarded, never retained or replayed into the new challenge; only the held, non-secret action state survives; the pre-expiry warning renders only the remaining time of the server's challenge_expires_at. The TTL and the failure count never change. Note: Whether the 'essential' exception covers a security challenge window is for the second rater / security lens; no exception is claimed here (Level A cannot carry a nomination). Adjudication: filed in #5196 (filing go, decision 2a; owner the auth surfaces, E09). ADJUDICATED (orchestrator, 2026-10-31, #1323 adjudication of record — 6543611748).

findings.title: DP-011: Step-up Confirm stays disabled with no text saying why; no format hint on the code field
findings.remedy: The required format is stated ('6-digit code from your authenticator app') and an invalid entry is described in text when the user tries to submit. Note: The typed-confirmation mismatch (case-sensitive target) behaves the same way (silent disabled Confirm). Per BQ-10 that is a note for S08 #1322, not a finding, and no remedy may relax it. Also touches SC 3.3.2. Adjudication: filed in #5196 (filing go, decision 2a; owner the auth surfaces, E09). ADJUDICATED (orchestrator, 2026-10-31, #1323 adjudication of record — 6543611748).
findings.ownerReason: name/role/value and error identification are a primitive and pattern contract

findings.remedy: The third error is described in text before or as the dialog closes ('Incorrect code. Too many attempts: the invitation was not sent. ...'), announced assertively. Adjudication: filed in #5196 (filing go, decision 2a; owner the auth surfaces, E09). ADJUDICATED (orchestrator, 2026-10-31, #1323 adjudication of record — 6543611748).

findings.screenSource: routing attribution: E08-D12 §2 inventory L133 and L153 (SCR-100 Watchlist panel, CMP-161 WatchlistRow; D07 is the watchlist) and §11 L522's own remediation rows E08-S08 (#4702)
findings.title: `color.data-confidence.disconnected.text` and `.reconnecting.text` resolve to `{color.text.primary}`, identical to `.live.text` in every theme (`TOK`:617–:620, :645–:648; `D07`:88 D3, :562 "ΔE 0"), so a disconnected row's text is visually the live text; the state is carried by the panel status words and the container class (`D07`:89, :566) (`05` §4)
findings.remedy: the DS change request D07 raised (DS-CR-1, `D07`:88: re-point both to `color.text.secondary` and add `.surface` → `color.surface.sunken`, in all three themes), lifted into the pack; until it merges, D07's fallback (`color.text.primary` at `opacity.muted` on sunken, `D07`:563–:565) is the build rule
findings.ownerReason: token pair identical to the live text colour: a contrast and colour-independence design change

findings.title: SCR-104's announcement rule reads "polite, once, after the request settles" and names the number only by derivation — "Polling therefore speaks at most once per 5 s scan" (`D08`:287) — while `D08H`:91 lists "the maximum announcement rate as a number" as not found (`05` §6.2; WCAG 4.1.3). Minor, not Blocking: the rate is stated, by derivation, at `D08`:287, so R-1's "no stated maximum rate" test is not met
findings.remedy: the number stated in the pack and the parent: at most one announcement per 5 s scan per state class, once per user change, plus one on a stale or inputs-stale exit (BG-05); D08's §12.2 sentence follows at its next text touch (A-4)
findings.ownerReason: the announcement rate is a live-region rule

findings.title: `14`:2329 lists SCR-104's components as "CMP-011 Tag / Chip, CMP-024 Sparkline, CMP-026 EmptyState, CMP-049 Table, CMP-055 FilterBar, CMP-056 ColumnPicker" with neither CMP-079 RbacGate nor CMP-019 Icon `lock`, while D08 gates "Add to watchlist…", "Send matches to watchlist…" and "Create alert…" as T2 (`D08`:263–:265) and its frame register binds CMP-079 (`D08`:425) (`DS`:59–:61 G-T2.6). Minor: the control itself is gated and binds CMP-079 (`D08`:263–:265, :425); only `14`'s component list omits it, so this is a catalogue-documentation miss, not a G-T2 behaviour miss
findings.remedy: `14`:2329 gains "CMP-079 RbacGate, CMP-019 Icon (`lock`)" (A-1, the catalogue owner's docs PR via #2701); the pack lists them for E08-S11
findings.ownerReason: no design-ticket rule matches this finding's criterion or class

findings.title: SCR-102 / SCR-041 name the high-contrast rendering ("The highlight is weight (600 vs 400), so it holds in high contrast", `D05`:351) and no `forced-colors` rendering for the active option's bar and fill, the ARMED chip's fill or the focus ring (`D05`:349–:354) (`DS`:67–:68 R2)
findings.remedy: the `forced-colors` rendering in `D06`:450–:453's form: the bar and the chip borders as `CanvasText`, the ring a real `outline`, weight and words carrying the match and the states (§1.6 default 2); D05's §9.4 follows at its next text touch

findings.title: SCR-104's token section measures contrast in three themes and the 200 % reflow (`D08`:331–:349, :224) and names no `forced-colors` rendering for the sparkline stroke, the estimated badge fill, the stale tint or the focus ring (`DS`:67–:68 R2)
findings.remedy: the `forced-colors` rendering in `D06`:450–:453's form: the stroke and the badge outline as `CanvasText`, the ring an `outline`, the words "(estimated)", "Stale 15s" and "Inputs stale" carrying the states (§1.6 default 2); D08's §14 follows at its next text touch
findings.ownerReason: contrast measured in the token section
